$description: VAPTLens design tokens v8, exported from design/tokens.json. Do not edit by hand.

canvas.$description: Console background, near-black. Everything sits on it.

surface-100.$description: Widget cards, tables, drawers, the top nav bar. The default ground for all text tokens.

surface-200.$description: Raised or hovered rows, table header row, input fields, the slicer panel.

surface-300.$description: Pressed state, selected table row, skeleton loaders, tooltip ground.

border.$description: Hairline dividers, card outlines, table cell rules. Decorative only: never the only cue for a control.

border-strong.$description: Input and checkbox outlines, secondary button border, focus-free control edges. Meets 3:1 on `canvas`, `surface-100`.

ink.$description: Primary text: titles, values, table cells. On `canvas`, `surface-100`, `surface-200`, `surface-300`.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text: labels, axis ticks, column headers, captions. 4.5:1+ on every surface.

ink-subtle.$description: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholder text, empty-state hints. On `canvas`, `surface-100`, `surface-200` only.

lens.$description: Selection and action inside the console: links, checked boxes, on-toggles, the selected chart mark, the active tab underline. Deliberately monochrome (near-white on dark, near-black on light) so severity is the only colour in the data.

lens-strong.$description: Hover and pressed state of `lens` fills and links.

lens-soft.$description: Tinted ground for active filter chips, selected quadrant, the active-filter ring's fill.

on-lens.$description: Text on `lens` fills (checked states, heat steps 4–5).

signal.$description: The console's signal amber: the logo mark, the live status LED, the active-view marker in the sidebar, primary buttons and the focus ring. Chrome only. Never used inside charts, tables or badges, where colour means severity.

signal-soft.$description: Ground for the active sidebar item and the status strip's LOCAL pill.

on-signal.$description: Text and icons on `signal` fills (primary buttons).

scrim.$description: Backdrop behind modals and the host/finding drawer.

tooltip-bg.$description: Tooltip and chart-tooltip ground; text on it is `ink`.

focus-ring.$description: 2px solid outline at 2px offset on every focusable control. Signal amber on dark themes; a darker amber on light (3:1+).

sev-critical.$description: Critical: CVSS 9.0–10.0, SLA 14 days. Badge dot, badge text on `sev-critical-soft`, chart series, heatmap cells. Always paired with the word 'Critical': critical and high differ mostly by hue. In `cvd` it moves to magenta and sits darker than High; in charts add the ◆ marker.

sev-high.$description: High: CVSS 7.0–8.9, SLA 30 days. Badge dot, badge text on `sev-high-soft`, chart series, heatmap cells. Always paired with the word 'High': critical and high differ mostly by hue.

sev-medium.$description: Medium: CVSS 4.0–6.9, SLA 90 days. Badge dot, badge text on `sev-medium-soft`, chart series, heatmap cells. Always paired with the word 'Medium': critical and high differ mostly by hue.

sev-low.$description: Low (cyan, kept clear of the brand blue): CVSS 0.1–3.9, SLA 180 days. Badge dot, badge text on `sev-low-soft`, chart series, heatmap cells. Always paired with the word 'Low': critical and high differ mostly by hue.

sev-info.$description: Info: CVSS 0.0, SLA 360 days. Badge dot, badge text on `sev-info-soft`, chart series, heatmap cells. Always paired with the word 'Info': critical and high differ mostly by hue.

sev-critical-soft.$description: Badge and chip ground for Critical; `sev-critical` text on it holds 4.5:1.

sev-high-soft.$description: Badge and chip ground for High; `sev-high` text on it holds 4.5:1.

sev-medium-soft.$description: Badge and chip ground for Medium; `sev-medium` text on it holds 4.5:1.

sev-low-soft.$description: Badge and chip ground for Low; `sev-low` text on it holds 4.5:1.

sev-info-soft.$description: Badge and chip ground for Info; `sev-info` text on it holds 4.5:1.

status-ok.$description: SLA Met, Resolved, Verified Remediated, compliance ≥ 80%. Green in `dark`/`light`/`hc`; blue in `cvd` so it never pairs red-vs-green with `status-danger`. Always with a word or check icon.

status-warn.$description: SLA at risk (≤ 7 days left), compliance 50–79%, Pending Verification.

status-danger.$description: SLA Breached, compliance < 50%, New Introduced Risk, destructive buttons.

status-danger-soft.$description: Ground for Breached pills and the danger banner.

threat-zeroday.$description: Zero-day tag and trend line. Sits apart from the severity ramp on purpose.

threat-kev.$description: CISA KEV tag and trend line; KEV items are weaponized, so they share the critical hue and carry a flame icon.

threat-ransomware.$description: Ransomware Threat tag and trend line, with a skull icon.

chart-1.$description: Categorical series 1 (blue) for non-severity dimensions (tool, team, subnet, scan batch). Use in order; never more than six series before grouping into 'Other'.

chart-2.$description: Categorical series 2 (teal) for non-severity dimensions (tool, team, subnet, scan batch). Use in order; never more than six series before grouping into 'Other'.

chart-3.$description: Categorical series 3 (amber) for non-severity dimensions (tool, team, subnet, scan batch). Use in order; never more than six series before grouping into 'Other'.

chart-4.$description: Categorical series 4 (pink) for non-severity dimensions (tool, team, subnet, scan batch). Use in order; never more than six series before grouping into 'Other'.

chart-5.$description: Categorical series 5 (lime) for non-severity dimensions (tool, team, subnet, scan batch). Use in order; never more than six series before grouping into 'Other'.

chart-6.$description: Categorical series 6 (slate) for non-severity dimensions (tool, team, subnet, scan batch). Use in order; never more than six series before grouping into 'Other'.

chart-grid.$description: Chart gridlines and zero-line ticks. Decorative; one step off the card ground.

chart-axis.$description: Axis tick labels and legend text (12px `caption`).

chart-selected.$description: Outline of the cross-filtered chart mark (2px). Unselected marks drop to `opacity-dimmed`.

heat-0.$description: Sequential ramp step 0 (of 0–5) for density: subnet × month, aging buckets, the RACI matrix. Low → high runs dark → bright in dark themes and light → dark in light. Text on steps 1–2 is `ink`, on 4–5 `on-lens`; step 3 carries no text.

heat-1.$description: Sequential ramp step 1 (of 0–5) for density: subnet × month, aging buckets, the RACI matrix. Low → high runs dark → bright in dark themes and light → dark in light. Text on steps 1–2 is `ink`, on 4–5 `on-lens`; step 3 carries no text.

heat-2.$description: Sequential ramp step 2 (of 0–5) for density: subnet × month, aging buckets, the RACI matrix. Low → high runs dark → bright in dark themes and light → dark in light. Text on steps 1–2 is `ink`, on 4–5 `on-lens`; step 3 carries no text.

heat-3.$description: Sequential ramp step 3 (of 0–5) for density: subnet × month, aging buckets, the RACI matrix. Low → high runs dark → bright in dark themes and light → dark in light. Text on steps 1–2 is `ink`, on 4–5 `on-lens`; step 3 carries no text.

heat-4.$description: Sequential ramp step 4 (of 0–5) for density: subnet × month, aging buckets, the RACI matrix. Low → high runs dark → bright in dark themes and light → dark in light. Text on steps 1–2 is `ink`, on 4–5 `on-lens`; step 3 carries no text.

heat-5.$description: Sequential ramp step 5 (of 0–5) for density: subnet × month, aging buckets, the RACI matrix. Low → high runs dark → bright in dark themes and light → dark in light. Text on steps 1–2 is `ink`, on 4–5 `on-lens`; step 3 carries no text.

report-slate.$description: Executive Report "slate" theme: cover band and section header bars (default).

on-report.$description: Text and the logo on any `report-*` band (≥ 10:1 on all three).

report-rule.$description: Hairline rules and the accent underline under report section titles, on white paper.

on-avatar.$description: Initials on generated avatar hues; hsl(h 45% 32%) keeps every hue at or above 4.5:1.

space-0.5.$description: Hairline nudges: badge dot offset, underline gap.

space-1.$description: Icon-to-text gap in badges, chips and tags.

space-2.$description: Control inner gap, list item padding, table cell block padding.

space-2.5.$description: Input horizontal padding, compact card padding.

space-3.$description: Table cell inline padding, card header gap, toolbar gap.

space-4.$description: Card padding, grid gutter, page side gutter on phones.

space-5.$description: Card padding on wide screens, drawer padding.

space-6.$description: Section gap between card rows, modal padding.

space-7.$description: Gap between page header and content.

gap-grid.$description: Between cards in a grid; dashboard grid margin.

gap-inline.$description: Inline controls, chip and filter rows.

gap-tight.$description: Icon to label, tag to tag.

inset-overlay.$description: Modal and drawer head, body, footer.

radius-none.$description: Table cells, full-bleed bars, heat cells joined edge to edge.

radius-xs.$description: Chart bars (top corners), progress fills, focus marks, kbd inner.

radius-sm.$description: Badges, tags, chips, checkboxes, heatmap cells, kbd keys.

radius-md.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls, menu items.

radius-lg.$description: Cards, panels, KPI tiles, table wrappers, callouts.

radius-xl.$description: Drawers (leading corners), modals, popovers, command palette.

radius-2xl.$description: Large feature surfaces: onboarding, report cover.

control-xs.$description: Icon buttons inside table rows and chips.

control-sm.$description: Compact buttons in card headers and table rows, chips.

control-lg.$description: Primary page actions, search bar, login.

touch-min.$description: Minimum hit area on touch (WCAG 2.5.5 / Apple HIG).

icon-sm.$description: Icons inside badges and dense rows.

content-max.$description: Max width of the main content column.

measure.$description: Max width of running text (readable line length).

chip-height.$description: Tags, text badges, inline meters (CVSS metric, SLA countdown).

count-height.$description: Numeric count bubbles on icons and tabs.

bp-xs.$description: Small phones: single column, icon-only buttons.

bp-sm.$description: Chips wrap to two lines; KPI row becomes 2-up.

bp-md.$description: Tablet: nav rail collapses to bottom bar; drawers go full width.

bp-lg.$description: Laptop: two-column grids collapse; side panels stack.

bp-xl.$description: Desktop: full dashboard grid, side filter panel.

bp-2xl.$description: Wide: content-max reached, extra columns on boards.

z-grid.$description: Dashboard widgets at rest; sticky table cells inside a card.

z-header.$description: App top bar and nav rail.

z-modal.$description: Modals, command palette and their scrim.

z-popover.$description: Popovers opened from inside a modal or drawer.

z-tooltip.$description: Tooltips: always on top of content.

opacity-hover.$description: Hover state layer (signal or text tint over a surface).

opacity-dimmed.$description: Unselected chart marks while a cross-filter is active.

opacity-strong.$description: Overlays that must stay nearly opaque.

duration-slower.$description: Large expansion, important system notifications (Carbon slow-01).

duration-loop.$description: Pulse, skeleton shimmer, indeterminate progress, ping.

ease-exit.$description: Elements leaving the screen (Carbon productive exit).

text-2xs.$description: Smallest legible size: chart ticks, tiny chip text. Never smaller.

text-xs.$description: Card titles (mono caps), dense table meta.

text-base.$description: Console default: table cells, inputs, list rows.

text-lg.$description: Sheet and section headings, emphasised numbers.

text-3xl.$description: Page titles on compact layouts, score readouts.

text-4xl.$description: Report titles, gauge and donut totals.

kpi.$description: KPI and threat-index numbers. Plex Sans Condensed with tabular figures: narrow, tall, and it reads like an instrument readout.

title-lg.$description: View titles and report section headings.

body.$description: Descriptions, drawer prose, report narrative. 22px leading for reading.

body-sm.$description: Table cells, list rows, form inputs: the console's default density.

body-strong.$description: Finding titles in tables, lists and cards.

card-title.$description: Panel and column headers, uppercase. The console signature.

label.$description: Uppercase eyebrows over KPIs, status-strip keys, column headers. Always `ink-muted` or `ink-subtle`.

mono.$description: Hosts, IPs, ports, CVE and plugin IDs, tickets. Turn on slashed zero (`font-feature-settings: "zero"`) so 0 and O never mix in IPs.

mono-sm.$description: IDs inside badges and chips, CVSS in dense lists.

shadow-xs.$description: Pressed buttons, inset segmented tracks, subtle separation.

shadow-sm.$description: Resting cards and panels (with the border hairline).

shadow-md.$description: Hovered tiles, sticky headers once scrolled, dragged items.

shadow-focus.$description: Keyboard focus on every interactive element (offset ring that reads on any surface).

ring-inset.$description: Hairline drawn without affecting layout (selected cells, inputs inside tables).

ring-offset.$description: Separates avatars and badges from what they overlap.

shadow-focus-soft.$description: Soft focus halo on large inputs.
